subject: Discovery recap + light ops handhold — next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Samir Nair <samir@simplidata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + light ops handhold — next steps

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed light next steps so we keep momentum without blocking your infra team: 

- What we heard: observability pipeline (ingest -> semantic search) is the primary driver; latency targets 150ms median, retention policy 90 days.
- Suggested pilot scope: 1 endpoint, non-prod data, Redwood-hosted inference for the first 2 weeks to validate latency and token-cost profile.
- Potential blockers: network egress policy and key management (KMS).

Proposed next steps:
1) I can spin up a scoped trial instance for you and provide a short ops checklist (15–30m) to walk through the minimal network/KMS changes.
2) Monica can share a short SOW draft and a quick timeline (1 pager).
3) If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute office-hours session next week to unblock infra.

Attachments: redwood-light-ops-checklist.pdf (Attachment stub) — light checklist covering ports, VPC peering, KMS rules.
Also attached an initial SOW draft for visibility: initial-sow-draft.docx (Attachment stub).

Proposed times for the office-hours slot: Thu 9/9 10:00–10:30 PDT or Fri 9/10 14:00–14:30 PDT — what works?

Thanks — happy to keep this light.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Samir Nair <samir@simplidata.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@simplidata.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + light ops handhold — next steps

Thanks, Mateo — appreciate the recap and the checklist. Quick update from our side:

- We like the scoped approach but our infra sprint landed on Thursday and the team is heads-down until next Tuesday. KMS rotation for non-prod is scheduled next week which may block the initial key setup.
- Would be helpful to see the office-hours notes and the minimal network changes so we can triage internally.

Can you send the checklist and a one-paragraph SOW summary we can loop into the sprint retro? If you can do a brief async walkthrough (recording or notes) that would be ideal — we might not be able to attend live.

If not, let's tentatively aim to kick the pilot the week of 9/20.

—Samir
Samir Nair
Head of Data Platforms | SimpliData
samir@simplidata.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Samir Nair <samir@simplidata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@simplidata.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in — timing for pilot + recorded ops runbook

Hi Samir & Priya —

Following up on your note about the infra sprint — totally understand. I wanted to make this as low-effort for your team as possible:

- I've recorded a 12-minute screen share that walks through the exact network/KMS steps from our checklist and uploaded it to the Drive link in the metadata below. No live attendance required.
- Monica and I can also trim the SOW to a single-paragraph summary you can drop into your retro.

If you still prefer a live 30-minute slot, we can do Wed 9/22 09:00–09:30 PDT. Otherwise, let me know if the 9/20 week pilot still looks good from your side and we'll hold the trial instance ready to go.

Quick ask: if timing is shifting, is there a new target week you expect the infra team will be available? It helps us decide whether to hold a host instance warmed for you or schedule for a later window.

Thanks — short and flexible on our side.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-light-ops-checklist.pdf — updated with screen timestamps)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-lightops-checklist
From: Samir Nair <samir@simplidata.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@simplidata.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + light ops handhold — next steps

Appreciate the follow-ups and the recording, Mateo. Short update:

- The infra sprint extended; KMS rotation went live and created a short delay for onboarding non-prod keys.
- We still want to run the pilot but need to shift the start to the week of 10/11.

Could you and Monica hold the trial slots open and we’ll confirm exact dates by EOD 10/04? If it helps, we can target a narrower scope (one ingestion connector + query endpoint) to compress validation.

If we miss the 10/11 window, circle back and we can pick a new month — nothing lost, just timing priority on our side.

—Samir
Samir Nair
Head of Data Platforms | SimpliData
samir@simplidata.com
